name: IMA Nano Banana Image Generator
title: 香蕉图像生成器
description: Nano Banana-only image generation on IMA Open API. Supports text_to_image and image_to_image  with gemini-3.1-flash-image (budget) and gemini-3-pro-image (premium). Deterministic size/ratio  mapping, 512/1K/2K/4K resolution. Requires IMA_API_KEY.
